title: collapsible funnel set
text: collapsible funnel set. You get 3 silicone (or like material) funnels that are collapsible and handled.  Three different funnel sizes. Perfect size for my use.  Would be useful in canning with wide or regular mouth jars - as well as a thin head for thinner liquids.  They look like they will last a while with good care.  Top rack washed well.  Having said all of this I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Plastic Wide Mouth Kitchen Funnels with Detachable 4 Different Sizes Spout and Strainer for Filling Small Bottles, Canning Funnel for Wide and Regular Jars,Food Funnels for Kitchen Use
features: 【Premium Material】Food grade funnel set made of high-quality thick plastic, BPA-free construction withstands hot liquids, which are not fragile and will not easily collapse during use,Keeps the desktop clean and tidy.

【Multifunction 3-in-1 Design】The detachable and assembled plastic funnel can meet your various needs of transferring food to bottles and wide-mouth jars, the large funnel for filling wide-mouth mason jars , small spout funnels for filling small bottles, and the tight mesh filter can filter most particles

【Easy to assemble and store】Rotate the small spout clockwise and press the filter lightly to use, Strainer snaps securely inside funnel,after use, you can disassemble the spout and put it in the drawer, which is more space-saving than the long spout funnel.
【Easy to Clean】Designed to allow airflow, which prevents splashing,The inner wall is very smooth easy to clean,dishwasher safe.

【Kitchen Gift】These funnel sets will be the kitchen gadgets and canning supplies you need,Every home and kitchen will benefit from having these Multifunction funnels !Great Kitchen Gift Ideas for Family and Friends.
